# Data statement

Copy to `docs/data-statement.md`. Owner: data engineer.

- **Dataset:** name, version, date received, file list (no contents)
- **Provider and legal basis:** who provided it, permission to use it for the course, conditions
- **Curation rationale:** why this data answers the question
- **Population:** who is in the data (age, gender, region, activity level); who is missing
- **Collection:** how the app records swipes, matches, chats; time span
- **Anonymisation:** method, whether identifiers are consistent across tables, residual re-identification risk
- **Personal data audit:** results of the bio check (names, phones, social links) and how they were handled
- **GDPR / platform terms:** assessment, storage location, retention and deletion
- **Known limitations and biases:**
- **Access and reproducibility:** what can be shared publicly, what cannot, how others can obtain the data
